title: L3Harris to Present at Two Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: L3Harris Technologies President and CEO Sam Mehta and Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Ken Sharp will present at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference on Thursday, Dec. 3, in New York City.
body_markdown:
**MELBOURNE, Fla., Nov. 24, 2026** — L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) President and CEO Sam Mehta and Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Ken Sharp will present at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference at 11:30 a.m. ET on Thursday, Dec. 3, in New York City. The presentation will stream live on[L3Harris.com](https://www.l3harris.com/events/shareholder/goldman-sachs-industrials-and-materials-conference) , with a recording available following the event.


Mehta and Sharp will also present at the Bernstein Insights 5th Annual Industrials & Energy Forum at 3 p.m. ET on Tuesday, Dec. 8, in New York City. The presentation will stream live on[L3Harris.com](https://www.l3harris.com/events/shareholder/bernstein-insights-5th-annual-industrials-energy-forum) , with a recording available following the event.


**About L3Harris Technologies**


L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security. Visit[L3Harris.com](https://www.l3harris.com/) for more information.
